I have been farming this rice plot for many years using the ways my mother taught me. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizers or pesticides from the shop, but I have some cow manure from our animals that I will spread on the field before planting. I will use the rice seed I saved from last season's harvest because it has always grown well here, and I rely on the rains to fill the paddy since we have no irrigation canal. My children and I will do all the work ourselves—planting, weeding, and harvesting—because the plot is small and we cannot afford to pay workers.
